content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I'm facing a similar issue. Communication between AWS and my [product_name] (PLC) works fine, but when using [product_name] (LWE), there's no connection with the AWS shadow or my PLC. The configuration has been set up correctly. --- Split from Workaround: Deploy the [product_name] project to AWS.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble connecting the [product_name] tool to the AWS shadow service, even though AWS and the [product_name] PLC communicate without problems. The challenge seems specific to [product_name] integration and not the general PLC-AWS setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to successfully connect with both AWS shadow service and the [product_name] PLC, maintaining the same reliability as direct AWS-PLC communication.
